entities.name: Christianisation of Norway
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Olaf Tryggvason and Olaf Haraldsson (St. Olaf) Christianising Norway by force, Olaf Haraldsson's death at Stiklestad (1030) making him Norway's patron saint, and Harald Hardrada's defeat at Stamford Bridge (1066) ending the Viking Age.
